terms.name: Phenotype
terms.definition: The observable physical appearance of a dragon resulting from its genotype.

terms.name: Genotype
terms.definition: The genetic makeup of an individual; what genes it carries, visible or not.

terms.name: Heterozygous (Het)
terms.definition: Carrying two different alleles for a trait; one visible, one hidden (carrier).

terms.name: Homozygous
terms.definition: Carrying two identical alleles for a trait.

terms.name: Recessive
terms.definition: A trait that only appears when inherited from both parents.

terms.name: Dominant
terms.definition: A trait that appears when inherited from only one parent.

terms.name: Morph
terms.definition: A distinct color or pattern variation in bearded dragons.

terms.name: Line Breeding
terms.definition: Breeding closely related dragons to reinforce desired traits; requires careful planning.

terms.name: Outcross
terms.definition: Breeding unrelated dragons to introduce genetic diversity.

terms.name: Sex-Linked
terms.definition: Traits carried on sex chromosomes; inherited differently by males and females.

terms.name: Polygenic
terms.definition: Traits controlled by multiple genes, resulting in varying degrees of expression.

terms.name: Zygosity
terms.definition: The state of being homozygous or heterozygous for a trait.

terms.name: Allele
terms.definition: Different versions of a gene at the same location on a chromosome.

terms.name: Locus
terms.definition: The specific location of a gene on a chromosome.

terms.name: Clutch
terms.definition: A group of eggs laid by a female in a single breeding cycle.

terms.name: Sire
terms.definition: The male parent in a breeding pair.

terms.name: Dam
terms.definition: The female parent in a breeding pair.

terms.name: Incubation
terms.definition: The process of maintaining proper temperature and humidity for egg development.

terms.name: Hatchling
terms.definition: A newly born or hatched dragon.

terms.name: Poss. Het
terms.definition: Possibly carrying a hidden recessive trait but uncertain (Possible Heterozygous).

terms.name: UVB
terms.definition: Ultraviolet B radiation required for Vitamin D3 synthesis.

terms.name: D3
terms.definition: Vitamin synthesized from UVB exposure, necessary for calcium processing.

terms.name: Calcium
terms.definition: Essential mineral for bone development and muscle function.

terms.name: Desert
terms.definition: The natural arid habitat of most Pogona species.

terms.name: Husbandry
terms.definition: Appearance and health influenced by UVB, diet, and hydration.

terms.name: Enclosure
terms.definition: The managed habitat or tank where the dragon resides.

terms.name: Bioactive
terms.definition: A habitat using live substrate and cleanup insects (isopods/springtails).

terms.name: Substrate
terms.definition: The flooring material used inside the enclosure.

terms.name: Humidity
terms.definition: The level of moisture present in the air.

terms.name: Misting
terms.definition: Manual spraying of water for hydration and aiding in shed.

terms.name: Exotic
terms.definition: Pertaining to non-domesticated or unique pet species like reptiles.

terms.name: Temperature Gradient
terms.definition: A range of temperatures within the enclosure from hot to cool areas.

terms.name: Cool Side
terms.definition: The cooler area of the enclosure used for thermoregulation.

terms.name: UVA
terms.definition: Ultraviolet A light that influences behavior, appetite, and activity.

terms.name: Photoperiod
terms.definition: The daily cycle of light and darkness.

terms.name: Thermostat
terms.definition: A device used to regulate temperature automatically.

terms.name: Enrichment
terms.definition: Environmental additions that stimulate natural behaviors.

terms.name: Dubia
terms.definition: High-protein staple feeder insect (Blaptica dubia).

terms.name: Cricket
terms.definition: A common live feeder insect used for protein.

terms.name: Silkworm
terms.definition: A highly nutritious soft-bodied feeder larva.

terms.name: Superworm
terms.definition: Larvae of the Zophobas morio beetle, used as a feeder.

terms.name: Dusting
terms.definition: The act of coating feeder insects with calcium or vitamin supplements.

terms.name: Electrolyte
terms.definition: Minerals used for rehydration and physiological balance.

terms.name: Gut Loading
terms.definition: Feeding high-quality nutrients to insects before they are fed to the dragon.

terms.name: Staple Feeders
terms.definition: Primary insects used regularly as a main food source.

terms.name: Treat Feeders
terms.definition: Insects given occasionally due to high fat or low nutrition.

terms.name: Waxworm
terms.definition: A high-fat feeder insect used sparingly as a treat.

terms.name: BSFL
terms.definition: Black Soldier Fly Larvae; a calcium-rich feeder insect.

terms.name: Photophobic
terms.definition: Light-averse behavior commonly seen in feeder insects like roaches, causing them to avoid bright environments.

terms.name: Over-supplementation
terms.definition: Excessive use of vitamins or minerals that can lead to health issues.

terms.name: Mold
terms.definition: Fungal growth in the enclosure caused by excess moisture; can lead to respiratory issues and contamination.

terms.name: Ammonia Build-Up
terms.definition: Toxic gas produced from waste accumulation; harmful to the respiratory system.

terms.name: Overheating
terms.definition: Exposure to excessive temperatures leading to stress, organ failure, or death.

terms.name: Thermal Burn
terms.definition: Skin damage caused by direct contact with heat sources like heat rocks or unregulated lamps.

terms.name: UVB Burn
terms.definition: Damage to eyes or skin caused by excessive or improperly placed UVB lighting.

terms.name: Loose Substrate
terms.definition: Particulate flooring (sand, etc.) that can be ingested and lead to impaction.

terms.name: High Humidity
terms.definition: Excess moisture levels that increase risk of mold growth and respiratory infections.

terms.name: Poor Ventilation
terms.definition: Insufficient airflow leading to stagnant air, bacteria growth, and respiratory issues.

terms.name: Coccidia
terms.definition: A common intestinal parasite that causes diarrhea, weight loss, and dehydration.

terms.name: Parasite Load
terms.definition: The level of internal parasites present in the dragon's system.

terms.name: Bacterial Infection
terms.definition: Harmful bacterial growth caused by poor hygiene or contaminated environments.

terms.name: Impaction Risk
terms.definition: The likelihood of digestive blockage due to substrate or improper feeding.

terms.name: Choking Hazard
terms.definition: Food items that are too large or improperly sized for safe consumption.

terms.name: Egg Binding Risk
terms.definition: Conditions that increase the likelihood of a female being unable to lay eggs.

terms.name: Unsanitary Enclosure
terms.definition: A dirty habitat that promotes bacteria, parasites, and disease.
